title: 镜中的故事

content_zh:
这个世界平民被限制在土地上，鲜少有离开家园的。旅人大都是流浪诗人、渴望变强的骑士和一些有钱驾着马车带着仆人旅游的贵族，他们会选择住在酒馆、旅店、农庄、城堡以及教会，其中酒馆环境恶劣，是最下乘的选择，一般只有流浪诗人和教会苦修士居住，骑士们除非需要人照顾马匹，否则宁可露宿也不会住进酒馆。
对邢烨而言，酒馆是收集信息最好的地方，至于住宿环境，他并不是特别挑，再脏乱也可以忍耐一下。
这具身体的胸太大了，就算用布条紧紧缠住还是会有一点隆起，邢烨只好在衣服外面披上斗篷，找下人安置好马匹后，走进酒馆中要了一大杯啤酒，坐在角落里暗中偷听其他人谈话。
一口啤酒喝下去，邢烨用最大的毅力才控制住自己的面部肌肉，没有将酒吐出来。这是什么劣质啤酒，杀人一般的味道，真亏酒馆中的人能喝得那么嗨。
他听到了关于卢卡伯爵庄园起火的后续，酒馆中的人似乎很乐意谈论贵族因为生活胡闹荒唐而害死自己的事情，大家纷纷认为卢卡伯爵是在与女仆玩花样时，烛台倒下去点燃窗帘与床单引起火灾。他没有子女，倒是有两个没有继承爵位的弟弟，现在他们两个正快马加鞭地赶往卢卡伯爵的城堡，争抢他的遗产和爵位。
两个弟弟没人关心哥哥是怎么死的，确切地说死得好。他们并没有惩罚庄园中的仆人，反而为了拉拢他们发了一些奖励。
这么一来，克莱尔居住的村庄也不会被波及。
一切有些顺利得过头了……邢烨暗暗想道，这些只是他的设想，虽然有很大概率实现，但也不会这么顺利，为什么会这样？
手环上似乎有新消息提示，不过现在人多，就算其他人看不到手环也不方便查看。
邢烨一口一口地将啤酒全部喝光，接下来又要了一杯葡萄酒，忍受着黑醋一般味道，继续听小道消息。
最近大家热议的除了卢卡伯爵的财产继承问题，还有女王的生日。再过半个月就是女王五百岁的生日了，贵族们都在为这位女王准备礼物。
等等，五百岁生日？
邢烨险些将黑醋口感的葡萄酒喷出去，旁白在介绍故事背景时的确是说过很久很久以前，但他没想到时间要追溯到五百年之久！
难道真的是类似童话一般的世界？可是听了半天也没听到关于魔法、巨龙、精灵、矮人、冒险者一类的事情，而且他现在只是一个连初始技能都无法使用的新人，如果第一个世界难度就这么大，那根本没有赢的可能性。
收集了一晚上大概也只有这么点消息，邢烨回到自己定的单人房间，一进门就皱了皱眉，屋子里很潮不说，墙壁上还爬着一些令人一言难尽的虫子。
他将斗篷脱下铺在床上才觉得舒服了些，点开手环，发现一个灰色的图标亮了起来。
游戏奖励：恭喜玩家淘汰第一个对手，系统赠送玩家一次设定剧情的机会。由于玩家未在一小时内使用该权利，系统默认将本次机会用于卢卡伯爵死亡事件上。
原来如此，这条信息为邢烨解释了心中的疑惑。游戏奖励没有像旁白一样自动弹出，导致他错过了设定时间，不过就算他注意到了，也只会用在卢卡伯爵后续处理上，现在正好是他想要的结局。
关于女王寿命的事情，可能还需要问问这面有灵性的镜子。
镜子一直放在装衣服（女装）的包袱中，邢烨从一堆蕾丝中取出它。

镜面出现裂痕，邢烨摸了摸，发现镜面光滑，裂痕单纯是镜子中图案。
怎么好像一副崩溃了的样子？邢烨有些不解。
镜子：滚开啊！
邢烨顺着镜子照应的位置向天花板上看，墙上爬着一群长着须须的小强，它们各个膘肥体壮，好像还会飞。
镜子：快把我扣过去！
邢烨暗暗在镜子的属性上加一条“怕虫子”，难得体贴地用包裹中的备用斗篷，将自己和镜子盖住，镜子的情绪这才稳定下来，裂痕渐渐消失。
“我刚才酒馆中打探到消息，女王足足有五百岁，而你又是一面具有灵性的镜子，这其中有什么原因？”邢烨问道。
镜子的镜面突然画面一转，像手机放视频一般出现一个穿着华贵衣服的美丽女人，她一身骑马装，在一面全身镜前转了转，问道：“魔镜魔镜，谁是世界上最美的女人？”

content_en:
Civilians in this world are restricted to the land and rarely leave their homes. Travelers are mostly wandering poets, knights eager to become stronger, and some nobles who are rich enough to drive carriages and travel with servants. They will choose to stay in taverns, inns, farms, castles, and churches. Among them, taverns have a poor environment and are the lowest choice. Generally, only wandering poets and church ascetics live there. Knights would rather sleep in the open than live in a tavern unless they need someone to take care of their horses.
For Xing Ye, the tavern is the best place to collect information. As for the accommodation environment, he is not particularly picky. No matter how dirty it is, he can tolerate it.
The breasts of this body were too big. Even if they were tightly wrapped with cloth, they would still bulge a little. Xing Ye had no choice but to put on a cloak outside his clothes. After finding a servant to place the horses, he walked into the tavern and ordered a large glass of beer. He sat in the corner and secretly eavesdropped on other people's conversations.
After taking a sip of beer, Xing Ye used the utmost willpower to control his facial muscles and not spit out the beer. What kind of bad beer is this? It tastes like murder. It's a shame that the people in the pub can get so drunk.
He heard the aftermath of the fire in Count Luca's manor. The people in the tavern seemed happy to talk about the nobles who killed themselves because of their ridiculous life. Everyone thought that Count Luca was playing tricks with the maid, and the candlestick fell down and ignited the curtains and sheets, causing the fire. He has no children, but he has two younger brothers who have not inherited the title. Now the two of them are rushing to Count Luca's castle to fight for his inheritance and title.
Neither of the two younger brothers cares about how the older brother died, or rather, well. Instead of punishing the servants in the manor, they gave out some rewards in order to win over them.
In this way, the village where Claire lives will not be affected.
Everything was going too smoothly... Xing Ye secretly thought, these are just his assumptions. Although there is a high probability of them coming true, they won't go so smoothly. Why is this happening?
There seems to be a new message notification on the bracelet, but there are so many people now that it is inconvenient to check even if others can't see the bracelet.
Xing Ye drank all the beer in one gulp, then ordered another glass of wine, endured the taste of black vinegar, and continued to listen to the gossip.
Recently, in addition to the inheritance of Count Lucca's property, everyone has been hotly discussing the Queen's birthday. It will be the Queen's 500th birthday in half a month, and the nobles are preparing gifts for the Queen.
Wait, 500th birthday?
Xing Ye almost spit out the black vinegar-flavored wine. When the narrator introduced the background of the story, he did say that it was a long, long time ago, but he didn't expect that the time would go back five hundred years!
Is it really a fairy tale-like world? But after listening for a long time, he didn't hear anything about magic, dragons, elves, dwarves, adventurers, and so on. Moreover, he was just a newcomer who couldn't even use the initial skills. If the first world was so difficult, there was no possibility of winning.
After collecting about this amount of information all night, Xing Ye returned to the single room he had reserved. He frowned as soon as he entered the door. Not to mention that the room was very damp, and there were some unspeakable insects crawling on the walls.
He took off his cloak and laid it on the bed to feel more comfortable. He clicked on the bracelet and found a gray icon lighting up.
Game reward: Congratulations to the player for eliminating the first opponent. The system gives the player a chance to set the plot. Since the player did not use this right within one hour, the system defaults to using this opportunity for the death of Count Luca.
So that's it. This piece of information explained Xing Ye's doubts. The game rewards did not pop up automatically like the narration, causing him to miss the set time. However, even if he noticed it, it would only be used for Count Luca's follow-up processing. Now it is exactly the ending he wanted.
Regarding the Queen’s lifespan, you may want to ask this spiritMirror of sex.
The mirror had been placed in the bag of clothes (women's clothing), and Xing Ye took it out from a pile of lace.
There were cracks on the mirror surface. Xing Ye touched it and found that the mirror surface was smooth and the cracks were simply patterns in the mirror.
Why do you look like you've collapsed? Xing Ye was a little confused.
Mirror: Get away!
Xing Ye looked up at the ceiling from where the mirror was reflecting. There were a group of bearded beasts crawling on the wall. They were all fat and strong, and seemed to be able to fly.
Mirror: Take me over quickly!
Xing Ye secretly added "fear of insects" to the attribute of the mirror, and used the spare cloak in the package to cover himself and the mirror. Only then did the mood of the mirror stabilize and the cracks gradually disappeared.
"I just found out in the tavern that the queen is five hundred years old, and you are a spiritual mirror. What's the reason for this?" Xing Ye asked.
The mirror suddenly changed, and a beautiful woman wearing luxurious clothes appeared like a video on a mobile phone. She was dressed in a riding outfit, turned in front of a full-length mirror, and asked: "Mirror, Mirror, who is the most beautiful woman in the world?"
